name: Paving The Way
author: Bwavo
description: You are the transportation designer. Pave the way so our VIP (Visually Impaired Person) can navigate across town safely! Then, enter impact mode and experience realistic depictions of visual impairment to learn how important tactile paving is for a VIP's safety. Turn audio on for an immersive, impactful experience! Paving the Way was made for the Cross-Cultural Impact Jam by Brayden Jenkins, Lan Wang, and Naomie Allard.
